notes.text: See what changed in each update, before you install it and after.
Profile has a What’s new page with every version.
Smart connect only offers exits that answered on your network.
Pleat reconnects at once when you switch between Wi‑Fi and mobile data.
Protect shows how to keep Pleat running when your phone saves battery.
A short network drop no longer turns the VPN off.
Locations is a country list with the fastest one for you on top.
Activity shows your account, plan and data in one place.
